description: Recent stale/orphaned Bitcoin blocks and sidechain forks via Bitcoin Core getchaintips. Returns active tip, sidechain tips with height, hash, status, branch length, and block timestamp. Related tools on this server, for a different need: crypto_btc_blocks_range when you need Up to 144 consecutive Bitcoin blocks descending; crypto_btc_coin_days_destroyed when you need Bitcoin Coin Days Destroyed metric for recent days. Price: $0.005 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

limit.description: Maximum fork tips to return (1-50, default 10)

name: crypto_btc_chain_tips
title: Recent stale/orphaned Bitcoin blocks and sidechain forks
